LOWCOUNTRY UPDATE
Weekly Report from Congresswoman Nancy Mace

CONSTITUENT SERVICES:
Our casework team is managing 628 active cases and has returned over $40 million back to constituents with $26,400 returned just this past week alone.

IN THE DISTRICT:
Our team completed 13 events, meetings, ribbon cuttings, and site visits across the district this week, including:
➡️Leonardo DRS Meeting
➡️Mount Pleasant Waterworks Meeting
➡️Berkeley County Grant Specialist Meeting
➡️Meeting with Mayor Dickerso

Seniors are among the biggest targets for scammers. Every day, criminals prey on older Americans and steal hard-earned savings. Too often, the people who could help stop fraud lack the training needed to recognize the warning signs.

We voted YES on the Fraud and Scam Reduction Act to change this. This bill establishes a Senior Scams Prevention Advisory Group to develop educational materials for employees at retailers, financial services companies, and wire transfer companies, training them to i

From day one, we have been the biggest champion for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein. We were one of only four Republicans to force the release of the Epstein files. 

We will always stand for justice for those who have been silenced and ignored. They deserve the truth. They deserve accountability.

This isn't political for us, it's personal. Our moral compass will never allow us to look the other way.

Hold the Line.

Grooming children is not something to celebrate.

Not now, not ever. Protect our kids.

For years, the Left have used D.C.’s government as their ideological playground. 

We introduced the No DEI in DC Act to defund and eliminate the Left’s political machine inside D.C.’s government and bulldoze the DEI offices wasting taxpayer dollars on identity politics.

D.C. officials have kept taxpayers in the dark about how much of their money is being burned funding DEI programs and offices. 

The No DEI in DC Act will dismantle this bloated bureaucracy, defund its political brainwashing ma

The Big Beautiful Bill is for the hard-working, middle class American people. 

The largest tax cuts in American history. Real relief for the people who earn it. 

South Carolina families are feeling the effects of an administration putting America First.

Video

Trump Accounts will give children born between 2025 and 2028 a $1,000 investment to set their futures up for financial success and freedom.

Making America Great Again has always been about more than politics. It is about believing in our country. We work every single day to make sure the children of South Carolina grow up in a country worth inheriting. 

Financially strong. Safe. Free. Healthy. Full of opportunity.

Thank you, President Trump, for putting America First.

We voted YES on the Empowering States to Protect Seniors from Bad Actors Act.

This bipartisan bill establishes a grant program at the Securities and Exchange Commission to fund state-level efforts to protect older adults from bad actors looking to take advantage of them.

States know their communities. They know their seniors. Giving them the resources to push back against financial exploitation is exactly the kind of smart, targeted policy Washington should be delivering.

Protecting seniors f

It has been over a month since I lost my dad, and not a single day goes by without thinking about him and praying for him.

He gave 28 years to this country, earning the Distinguished Service Cross, Silver Star, Purple Heart, and multiple Bronze Stars for valor in Vietnam. He was the most decorated graduate The Citadel ever produced.

My dad spent most of his life serving this country. He did not do it for recognition or applause. He did it because service was who he was. And he made sure it bec

South Carolina taxpayers are not Big Tech's personal piggy bank. 

Data centers either pay their own way or they do not come here. There is no other option. 

South Carolina STRONG.

Taxpayers have had enough of watching their hard-earned dollars go to fraudsters abusing SNAP. We introduced the FAIR Act to fix it.

Our bill requires photo ID on every SNAP EBT card to shut down abuse in a program serving over 40 million Americans. Under current law, there is little to no identity verification when a SNAP EBT card is used, opening the door to card sharing, unauthorized purchases, stolen cards being exploited, and taxpayer dollars going to people who are not legally eligible at

We secured major wins in the FY26 National Defense Authorization Act, putting the Lowcountry and our national security first.

In the FY26 NDAA alone, we helped deliver more than $387.93 million in authorizations and extensions for critical infrastructure projects at Joint Base Charleston, MCAS Beaufort, and MCRD Parris Island.

We also secured key policy victories, including protecting women’s sports at Service Academies, expanding maternal health care for military families, ending DEI distract

Psalm 28:7 "If it wasn't for the struggles, you wouldn't be as strong as you are today. God is always building you up, Even when it feels like He's breaking you."

Everything we endure, we endure with God on our side.

Delivering results for South Carolina's students. 

We helped secure the Stronger Connections Grant for Jasper County School District and Real Champions, Inc. This funding places Advocate Mentors in elementary schools across Jasper County, ensuring students have the consistency, support, and encouragement they need to succeed both in and out of the classroom.

We will ALWAYS work to ensure South Carolina's youth have the resources and funding they need to grow and thrive. 

South Carolina STRONG

INTRODUCING: The Hire American Act.

This bill does exactly what its title says: hire American workers only. The legislation amends title 5 of the United States Code to restrict federal government employment to U.S. citizens and nationals ONLY.

American taxpayers foot the bill for every single federal job in this country. Every salary. Every benefit. Every pension. Those jobs belong to American workers, not non-citizens. Right now, there is no permanent law stopping a non-citizen from being hir
We want the Death Penalty for anyone who rapes a child.

God Bless our troops. Today, tomorrow, and every single day. 

Without the men and women who put on the uniform, there would be no America. 

Never forget it.

Strong countries need strong leaders. Under President Trump's leadership, America is the most respected country in the world.

America First, always.

South Carolina's justice system is broken. Our state has become a safe haven for pedophiles.

Predators walk free, get slaps on the wrist, and exploit every gap in a system failing to protect the most vulnerable among us.

We will not stop until it is fixed. Until our children are safe. Until justice is actually served.

Video

Women deserve to feel safe in their own private spaces. While the Left pushes to allow men into our spaces, we are taking action.

We introduced the Protecting Women's Private Spaces Act to keep biological males out of women's restrooms, locker rooms, and changing rooms on federal property.

We introduced the Stop the Invasion of Women's Spaces Act to make sure federal dollars do not go to any entity allowing men into women's private spaces.
